My Love Letter
// straight from my heart
❤
To My Dearest Farha...

From the very first moment I saw you, something changed inside me forever. Your smile — it's the most beautiful thing I have ever seen in my life. It makes my whole world brighter.

Every single day, I think about you. Every morning I wake up, you are my first thought. Every night before I sleep, you are the last thing on my mind. You have taken a permanent place in my heart — a place that belongs only to you.

Farha, you are not just beautiful on the outside — you are beautiful in every single way. The way you talk, the way you laugh, the way you carry yourself — everything about you is perfect to me.

I know I may not be perfect. I know I have flaws. But one thing I know for certain — my love for you is real, it is pure, and it is forever. No distance, no time, no difficulty can ever change that.

If you give me a chance, I promise I will spend every single day making you smile. I will be your best friend, your support, your happiness. You will never feel alone as long as I am here.

Farha... you are my dream, my hope, my everything. I love you more than words can ever express. 💕

Forever Yours,
Sahil ❤
